Priya Rao: Heads-up: LumenX renewal goes live 2026-03-28. They accepted new pricing but procurement says they'd like a PO + split invoice (US/EU). Need signature flow that supports delegated signer for EU entity. cc @Sophie - Legal
Marco Chen: Do we have final seat count and effective date? I saw 120 seats in the quote, any true-up?
Priya Rao: Quote final = 120 seats, start 2026-04-01. No true-up expected. They want monthly invoices split 70/30 by seat location.
Jordan Lee: From finance — need billing entities (legal names + VAT) and PO number before we send invoice. Also, are they paying by wire or CC?
Priya Rao: LumenX provided PO template attached in email. Payment: wire for EU, CC for US. PO pending number from their procurement.
Sophie - Legal: Quick check — delegated signer ok if DocuSign envelope sets signer role to 'Account Admin' and we include alternate signer clause. I'll draft clause today.
esig-bot: DocuSign envelope prepared (env_98765). Status: pending signature. Link: https://docusign.example/env_98765
Marco Chen: Can someone confirm the contract term change? They asked to shorten from 12m to 9m for EU entity only.
Priya Rao: Confirmed — EU entity requests 9mo term aligned to fiscal year. US stays 12mo. We need two signature paths or one multi-entity SOW.
Jordan Lee: For accounting, prefer single SOW split by billing entity. That avoids duplicate contracts. We can put billing table in SOW appendix.
Sophie - Legal: Agree. I'll produce a two-entity SOW appendix and update the DocuSign roles. Expect draft in 2 hours.
Priya Rao: Workflow: Sophie drafts SOW appendix + clause, I attach PO template and ask procurement for PO#, esig-bot will send envelope once Sophie signals ready. Marco to confirm pricing split in system.
Marco Chen: I'll update the billing split config and create invoice schedule: US monthly CC, EU monthly wire. Done ETA 3pm PST.
Priya Rao: Great — next steps assigned. I'll follow up with LumenX procurement and post PO# here. :thumbsup: 
esig-bot: Reminder scheduled: envelope env_98765 will auto-remind in 48h if unsigned.
Priya Rao: Thanks team, closing loop once signed.
